name: Utsutsu no Mugen
source:
The protagonist, Kaname Suzuhiro (name changeable), is a second-year university student. Kaname has the ability to experience lucid dreams and looks forward to meeting her late grandmother in her dreams every night.
Alongside her university friend, Masahi Tsuchiya, she leads a relatively fulfilling college life.

One day, in her dream, Kaname meets a man who calls himself a dream demon—Iska.
The dream world Iska takes her to is filled with all sorts of wonders, a truly dreamlike place.
There, she meets a quiet and enigmatic young man named Ibuki Kashiwaba.

As they spend time together in the dream world, Iska takes a liking to Kaname and traps her in the dream.

Will she ever wake up and return to reality?

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/11732]freem[/url]]
translation:
主人公铃广Kaname（姓名可更改）是一名大二学生。她能够做清醒梦，每晚都期待在梦中与已故的祖母相见。
与同校好友土屋真阳相伴，她过着还算充实的大学生活。

某天，Kaname在梦中遇见了一名自称梦魔的男子，伊斯卡。
伊斯卡带她前往的梦中世界，充满各种奇妙事物，宛如真正的梦境。
在那里，她结识了沉默寡言、谜团重重的青年柏叶一飒。

在梦中世界相处的过程中，伊斯卡渐渐喜欢上Kaname，将她困在了梦里。

她还能醒来，回到现实吗？
